description: How one Folketinget member voted: the member's individual votes (for, imod=against, fravaer=absent, hverken=neither) newest first, each with the vote id, date, the case (number, title), whether it was adopted, and the published conclusion. Identify the member by name or member_id. Narrow by session (code like 20261 = 2026-27), a date window (since/until), a case number (case "B 36" with session), or the vote kind. Returns total_matching, the page, and the member party. Pages with limit/offset. Danish text. Source: Folketinget, voting register.

case.description: Case number as printed, e.g. "B 36" (resolution), "L 12" (bill), with session.

member.description: Member name, e.g. "Christina Egelund". Give this or member_id.

session.description: Parliamentary session code, e.g. "20261" (2026-27), "20252" (2025-26 2nd session). With case it defaults to the current session.

since.description: Only votes on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

until.description: Only votes on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

name: folketinget_dk_member_votes
title: Folketinget Dk Member Votes
